chunks: And from his letter (peace be upon him) to the governors of the lands, concerning the meaning of prayer.

As for what follows, indeed Allah, the Exalted, did not make anything of His servants closer to Him than prayer, nor anything closer to Allah, Glory and Highness, than prayer. Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, says: 'O Children of Adam, We have sent down to you clothing to cover your nakedness and as adornment, and the clothing of righteousness - that is best.' So be steadfast in connecting to your Lord, and be maintainers of justice, and fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of prayer in Imam Ali's letter to the governors?
ai.summary: In this epistle, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs governors to prioritize the establishment of prayer as the foundational to social order, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the integration of ritual devotion with administrative justice. The text underscores that steadfastness in Salat is not merely personal piety but a public duty that anchors moral righteousness and prevents societal corruption. This perspective highlights the Imam's view of prayer as the spiritual pillar supporting the political and ethical structure of the Islamic community.

en.sayed-ali-raza: To the Governors of various places concerning prayers
